description.value: Ace Motel is a newly renovated motel located centrally in Princeton at the junction of BC-3, making it a natural stop for cyclists travelling the Similkameen corridor or the Kettle Valley Trail. Rooms and suites range from standard queens to 450 sq ft kitchenette suites, with pet-friendly options available. An on-site sushi restaurant (Mikado Sushi) and walking-distance access to downtown restaurants add convenience for touring cyclists ending a long day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed room and amenity information. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, laundry, drying areas, or bike tools anywhere on the site. Wi-Fi is confirmed repeatedly ('complimentary Wi-Fi', 'fiber internet WiFi'); nearby evening food is confirmed via on-site Mikado Sushi and walking-distance restaurants; Save on Foods is listed on the events/attractions page as a nearby resource, confirming nearby grocery.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating motel in Princeton with a functional website, booking system, and confirmed contact details. Useful stop for cyclists on BC-3 or the Kettle Valley Trail.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website notes EV chargers (Flo and Tesla) directly across the street — potentially useful context for e-bike touring cyclists, though on-site e-bike charging is not confirmed.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Mikado Sushi restaurant; website also notes walking distance to downtown restaurants and fast food places

Nearby grocery.detail: Save on Foods listed as a nearby attraction on the motel's events/attractions page

wow_evidence: newly renovated motel located centrally in Princeton at the junction of BC-3
